_comment: DRAFT portable-logic / LDR / VLH extended-profile example — NOT AAEI v1.2; does not validate against schemas/aaei_schema_v1_2.json — IBM z/OS COBOL SAM1/SAM2 Value Logic Identification · July 2, 2026
_source: github.com/IBM/zopeneditor-sample · LOC counted via wc -l on SAM1.cbl SAM2.cbl CUSTCOPY.cpy TRANREC.cpy RUN.jcl
problem_statement: IBM z/OS COBOL Customer File Update System contains 6 undocumented business rules and 3 critical data structure constraints (implicit decimal, REDEFINES sign convention, OCCURS 12 array) that exist only in the source code. Migration without extracting these rules risks corrupting account balances on day one.

_measurements.basis: wc -l on actual IBM zopeneditor-sample repository files

_business_rules_extracted.rule: Transaction batch must arrive sorted ascending by CUST-KEY or records are rejected — not re-sorted
BALANCE and ORDERS-YTD accept REPLACE and ADD. NAME accepts REPLACE only
Negative numeric values use '-' prefix in position 1 of UPDATE-DATA, stripped before COMP-3 conversion
Duplicate CUST-KEY on ADD transaction is rejected with error — existing customer cannot be re-added
New customer record initializes with zero balance, zero orders YTD, zero for all 12 monthly figures
CUST-DATA-1 (X5) and CUST-DATA-2 (X40) are undocumented overflow fields — inspect production data before migration
